lines: Their procession had moved throughout the night.
After pushing their way through the mountains and fields, the morning sun had already risen when they'd arrived at the border of Gosha.
Tokiko
Gosha territory lies ahead of us...
At first glance, it appeared to be your average, everyday path.
Kotaro, who had been leading Gaiza by the hand, spoke up curiously.
Kotaro
There's nothing here.
He was probably referring to the fact that, unlike Fuma Village, there wasn't a single watchtower.
Tokiko
Gosha is still a village under construction, so maybe that's why.
Kotaro
Is that right? I see.
Kotaro meekly nodded his head, but Tokiko had also been suspicious of that point.
Whether or not there were watchtowers, there was no way that they weren't being monitored from somewhere.
However, if it were a village under construction, it wouldn't be out of the ordinary to have a guard stationed for appearances.
In not doing so, she could sense Gosha'sーnamely, the Igawa Clan'sーintention to seek a new way of life for the Taimanin.
At this point, the government was trying to organize a group to oppose the demonic threat.
If realized, it would be the birth of the first Taimanin organization.
To that end, the government had been planning to move the Taimanin scattered all across the country to a single location.
It was here, Gosha, that had become the de facto headquarters of the Igawa Clan through cooperation with the government by the Igawa Clan elders, who had been close with the government for some time.
Through this cooperation, they planned to gather Taimanin from all over to create a completely new village.
For Tokiko, no for shinobi of the past, this defied all common sense.
While they served the rulers of the world with their extraordinary deeds, shinobi were also feared for those same deeds, at times facing regulations as a result.
Perhaps it was for that very reason that they had been able to maintain a reasonable distance from the powers that be and unite under one banner to protect themselves.
If the Igawa were the shinobi of the new age, then perhaps the antiquated Fuma being on the verge of ruin as they were now was bound to happen.
Those feelings must have shown on Tokiko's face, as Kotaro had looked up at her with concern.
Kotaro
What's wrong, Tokiko?
Tokiko
N-Nothing... I was just thinking about what comes next.
Tokiko took a moment to shake off the excessive thoughts that were bogging her down.
Tokiko
Perhaps because our surprise mobilization succeeded, we've been able to come this far without a fight.
Kotaro
We had good luck.
Tokiko
Yes. But that won't be the case from here on.
Tokiko
Master, Gaiza-sama, this is where it gets truly dangerous. Please make sure you stay by my side. No. Matter. What.
Gaiza
Hn...
Tokiko hadn't meant to frighten him, but Gaiza looked ready to burst into tears at her words.
Seeing that, Kotaro spoke up without a moment's delay.
Kotaro
Hear that, Gaiza? Tokiko said we're safe if we're by her side. So let's keep calm and stick together.
Gaiza
O-, okay. I will...
Gaiza gave a tentative nod.
Tokiko
Yes, please do.
Tokiko bent down so she was at eye level with them and patted each of their heads.
But in the next instant, she quickly stood up and sheltered them both behind her back.
Tokiko
Looking out, she saw a lone masked woman approaching rapidly from Gosha.
Fuma Ninja
Who goes there!?
Fuma Ninja
Don't come any closer!!
Shouts rose one by one from Tokiko's subordinates.
Fuma Kunoichi
Tokiko-sama, there's only one of them. What do you think?
They were all bewildered by the appearance of this lone individual that had approached them.
Apparently, so was their opposition. Both were in such unexpected situations that it made things all the more volatile.
Masked Woman
What are you all gathering out here for? ーNot that there are very many of you though. Who are you?
The woman spoke, having taken up position just far enough away where she could make the first move.
But silence was the only response she received.
Masked Woman
Well, I suppose it doesn't matter who you are. I don't mean any harm. Can you let me pass?
Fuma Ninja
Now that our existence is known, we can't let you through!
Masked Woman
So that means you've got your own dubious reasons for being here? Not like I'm one to talk though.
Fuma Ninja
A shinobi with surging bloodlust attempted to draw his weapon.
Tokiko
Wait!!
Tokiko sharply called him back.
After all, she had recognized this masked Taimanin before them.
Tokiko
I take it you are Oboro of the Kokawa Clan.
Oboro
And you must be...
Tokiko
We met once at a government-sponsored assembly for the establishment of Gosha Village.
Oboro
Ah, yes. The next butler of the Fuma head family. I remember you well.
Tokiko
I've now become the official butler.
Oboro
I see... You've certainly had it rough.
The woman then removed her mask, revealing her true face.
She was Kokawa Oboro.
She was a daughter of a branch family of the Kogawa Clan, a noted family of shinobi comparable to the Igawa Clan.
Although she was of the branch family, she was still a powerful member of the clan, as well as the guardian of its young head, Kokawa Asuka.
The reason she was here alone was unclear, but naturally, she must have known about the conflict between the Igawa and the Fuma Clans. And of the Fuma's defeat at their hands.
Tokiko
I sincerely apologize for my subordinate.
Oboro
I'm sorry as well. I had mistakenly thought you were some Igawa who were after me.
Oboro
I mean, who would ever expect to find the Fuma in a place like this?
Tokiko
You are correct.
Oboro
...May I ask you a question?
Tokiko
If it's something I can answer.
Oboro
What are you doing within a stone's throw of Gosha? I can't imagine it to possibly be the case, but if you're out here to avenge your master, then don't.
A touch of concern could be heard in Oboro's voice for Tokiko and the Fuma shinobi.
Tokiko
I have no intention of doing so. My master is alive and well.
As Tokiko said this, Kotaro peeked out a little from his hiding place behind her.
Oboro let out a slight chuckle to herself.
Oboro
So that cute little boy is the heir. All the more reason you should leave this place.
Oboro
Those Igawa bastards think they've taken over the world. They're even trying to subjugate my own family, the Kokawa.
Tokiko
They're are trying to subjugate the Kokawa?
Oboro
I'm just on my way back from flat-out refusing them.
Oboro huffed exasperatedly.
But Tokiko nodded with determination.
Tokiko

"That's why I've come to negotiate.
I'm here to meet that person that I met once at the assembly."
Oboro
You can't mean Igawa Asagi!?
The tone of Oboro's voice immediately jumped several octaves.
Tokiko
I do.
Oboro
What do you think that spoiled brat could possibly do?
Oboro had contemptuously shrugged her shoulders with that remark, but immediately corrected herself.
Oboro
No, I misspoke. I'm very sorry. I have no right to say such things to you.
Tokiko
You seem to have quite a distaste for her, Oboro-sama.
Oboro
She's someone with a very different mindset. Just doesn't sit well with me.
Oboro
But if it's Igawa Asagi, she might be able to help you. Still, most of Gosha are your enemies.
Oni-Masked Ninja
Quite so.
*Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh swoosh!!!*
As if he had been listening in on their conversation, a man dressed in black with a red Oni mask had appeared with his subordinates in tow.
Igawa Ninja
Ryoma-sama, those brats are remnants of the Fuma.
One of the shinobi had whispered this into the ear of the one with the red Oni mask.
Oboro
Speak of the devil, it's the elders' hunting dogs.
Oboro's remark was filled with sarcasm.
In other words, they were ninja forces under the direct control of the Igawa elders.
Ryoma
Kokawa Oboro. Hand over the girl and the brats.
Oboro
Do as you please. The Fuma survivors and the Kokawa have nothing to do with one another.
Ryoma
I'm relieved to hear that.
He did indeed sound happy to hear it.
He had a vulgar tone that sounded as if he was licking his lips under the red mask.

"Oboro glanced at Ryoma, then turned back to face Tokiko.
"
Oboro
Hey, why don't you come to Kokawa Village? If you do, you'll be guests of the Kokawa from now on.
Tokiko
I appreciate your kindness. However...
Oboro
You refuse. I figured you would say that.
Tokiko
I am sorry. We'll be entering negotiations from here.
Tokiko
But could you even call it negotiation if we had not managed to meet with Asagi through our own efforts?
Tokiko
Negotiations without military power are nothing more than jokes coming from the weak. No one will entertain us.
Oboro
So you'll display your strength here before you meet with Asagi...
Tokiko
Yes.
Oboro's eyes shot open.
Tokiko's determination had seemingly left her stunned.
To which she then apologized for her rudeness.
Oboro
I must admit I thought you were simply an eleven-year-old little girl.
Oboro
I hope that my own future master, Kokawa Asuka, will become a much Taimanin like you.
Tokiko
You overestimate me.
Oboro
Do your duty well. I'm looking forward to the next time we cross paths.
Tokiko
And I as well.
Taking one last look at Ryoma, Oboro then departed the Gosha border.
Ryoma, who should have been chasing after her, simply gazed upon her as she left.
Ryoma
I'll hunt Kokawa Oboro down sooner or later. But today, I eliminate the Fuma.
Tokiko
Shinobi of Igawa, I have come to meet with Igawa Asagi.
Ryoma
And you think I'm going to just let you waltz right on through?
Tokiko
I was simply paying the proper respects. Now then, I'll be making my way to Gosha Village through force!
Ryoma
You Fuma have outlived your time. I'll make this place your grave!
